entries.intro: Part of a dedicated R&D / product team building high-load fintech and crypto products end-to-end.

subSections.heading: Project 1 — Crypto analytics platform with an AI chat assistant
bullets: Architected and built a high-load backend on Node.js / Nest.js using a microservices architecture with Apache Kafka as the inter-service event bus.
Implemented real-time market-data ingestion directly from crypto exchanges over WebSocket, plus aggregation from external providers (CoinMarketCap, Messari, DeFiLlama, CoinGecko).
Designed a hybrid storage layer: PostgreSQL for transactional/relational data and ClickHouse for high-volume time-series and analytical queries.
Built an AI assistant / chat module that turns natural-language questions into portfolio insights and trading recommendations (LLM + AI SDK over the aggregated market data).
Integrated on-chain data via smart contracts (JSON-RPC / WebSocket RPC, Ethers.js, Solidity).
Delivered the frontend on Next.js / React with Zustand state management and real-time updates over WebSocket.
Containerized and orchestrated the platform with Docker and Kubernetes.
subSections.stack: Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Zustand, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Prisma, Redis, WebSocket, JSON-RPC, Ethers.js, AI SDK, LLM, Docker, Kubernetes

subSections.heading: Project 2 — Prediction market
bullets: Built a decentralized prediction market where users trade on the outcomes of real-world events.
Microservices backend (Node.js / Nest.js) integrated with on-chain smart contracts (Solidity, Ethers.js) for order settlement and payouts.
Multi-wallet support across EVM and non-EVM chains: MetaMask, WalletConnect, Unisat, Phantom.
Cross-platform delivery from a shared API: web (Next.js/React), mobile (React Native), and a Telegram Mini App.
Kafka-driven event pipeline; PostgreSQL + ClickHouse for orders/positions and analytics; Redis for caching and pub/sub.
Real-time order-book and price updates over WebSocket; deployed with Docker + Kubernetes.
subSections.stack: Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Solidity, Ethers.js, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis, WebSocket, Docker, Kubernetes
